description: Test vectors for buildShareText (apps/web/src/lib/share.ts), reused by the Flutter app (L-107). The text is the reference, the one-line insight (left out when empty) and the link, one per line. Whitespace means U+0020 SPACE and U+0009–U+000D (tab, line feed, vertical tab, form feed, carriage return) only: each run of it becomes one space and it is trimmed from both ends; every other space (NBSP, U+2009, U+FEFF…) is kept as is. Lengths, the room and the word-boundary search all count Unicode code points (Dart: runes), never UTF-16 units; the reference is cut to 100 and the insight to 160 code points, ellipsis included, the room is the first limit−1 code points, cut at the last U+0020 in it when that index is at least floor(room/2), else at the end of the room (mid-word), then trailing U+0020 and ,;:.–—- are dropped before the ellipsis; the query string is dropped so no tracking parameters travel; the fragment stays. Each invalid input throws.
